title: Mr. C NDE
content:
In October 2022, I fell into a coma due to long-term insomnia.

I had a serious insomnia problem. But, I ignored this condition at the time and did not sleep at all until the last week. I quickly called an ambulance, but then I passed out. It was 7 o'clock in the morning at my residence in Tokyo, Japan.

In the last moment I was awake, I felt the world was spinning and my heart was uncomfortable. I had difficulty breathing and there were stars in front of my eyes. After I fainted, I only felt that those feelings were moving away from me.

I thought at the time; I was afraid I was going to die. Then I seemed to see the figure of my father, but my father had passed away more than ten years ago. I still hear his voice. I didn't say anything, but I wondered in my mind if I had to go. But it was like a consciousness came to me and said strongly, 'No, you can't leave because you have unfinished work.' I woke up later in the hospital emergency room.

The impact of this incident on me is that I no longer let some diseases go unchecked. I was originally a very nihilistic person. Later, after this experience, I understood the value of my existence; because after all that time, I was told by that consciousness that I couldn't leave.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Sudden death due to inability to sleep for more than a week and a half. Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal. I feel as relaxed as I did when I didn't suffer from insomnia.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw my dad, but he had been dead for over ten years when this happened.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes When I fainted, I probably couldn't see anything, but I always felt bright.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others I understand, maybe I have some meaning too
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. I thought I might have to leave. I also saw my dad and wanted to leave with him, but that consciousness told me, 'You can't leave.'
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Atheist I'm not interested in this
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience 。
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: No. I feel my dad was there even though he has been dead for a long time.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes I feel like that awareness confirmed my meaning
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Large changes in my life. I feel like life has a little more meaning.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It's hard for me to tell you why consciousness is talking to me.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told some friends. In fact, before the ambulance was called, a friend urged me to call it; otherwise, I wouldn't have. I am grateful to that friend. Afterwards, I told her about that experience, including seeing deceased loved ones and hearing those words, and she said, 'Wow, you were really on the brink at that time.' Then our conversation ended.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. No why, just real feelings.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I used to be super afraid of death because I felt like I was worthless. But this experience confirmed my value to me. I was quite surprised, so I will live well for a while.
